scripts.db:setup: npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: node -e "const mysql = require('mysql2/promise'); const fs = require('fs'); const dotenv = require('dotenv'); dotenv.config(); (async () => { const conn = await mysql.createConnection({ host: process.env.DB_HOST || 'localhost', user: process.env.DB_USER || 'root', password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD || '', database: process.env.DB_NAME || 'finesse_db' }); const sql = fs.readFileSync('database/migrate_add_role.sql', 'utf8'); const statements = sql.split(';').filter(s => s.trim() && !s.trim().startsWith('--') && !s.trim().startsWith('USE')); for (const stmt of statements) { if (stmt.trim()) await conn.query(stmt); } await conn.end(); console.log('Migration complete'); })();"
